verdict.rationale: Alma's own pages describe it as a modern immigration law firm (alma-docs-8, alma-probe-1). They say every case is led by a dedicated attorney (alma-docs-7), and its process includes a strategy meeting with the case attorney (alma-docs-16). Together these amount to a stated attorney-led model rather than an unsupervised form service. Missing for 10: named attorneys or bar admissions on the provider's pages, an explicit statement that the attorney files as attorney-of-record, and independent or hands-on corroboration of attorney involvement.
